message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Run Tests

permissions:
  contents: read
on:
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'btquant/**'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'btquant/**'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements-dev.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Run tests with pytest
        run: |
          export PYTHONPATH="${PYTHONPATH}:${{ github.workspace }}"
          pytest tests/ --cov=. --cov-report=xml -m "not local_only"

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          file: ./coverage.xml",
  "rationale": "The workflow reinstalls Python dependencies from requirements-dev.txt on every run with no dependency cache, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and the cache input can be keyed to the dependency file. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern reports a modest aggregate benefit from caching dependency downloads, and the measured experiment (batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) shows adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip before pip install reduced median elapsed time by about 9.2% (554s to 503s) with all runs still passing. Adding a single cache step preserves the existing install, test, and coverage steps unchanged, keeps permissions at contents: read, adds no secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access, and invalidates the cache when requirements-dev.txt changes.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
